title: Legora deepens its NetDocuments partnership to bring governed institutional knowledge into agentic legal work
summary: New MCP connection lets mutual customers put the right documents from NetDocuments to work in Legora – searched and located automatically and governed by the access controls firms already trust.
body_markdown:
[Legora](https://legora.com/) , the agentic operating system for legal work, today announced a deeper integration with[NetDocuments](https://www.netdocuments.com/) , the intelligent document management system for legal professionals, built on NetDocuments' Model Context Protocol (MCP) connection. The new connection deepens a partnership the two companies[first announced on July 31, 2025](https://legora.com/newsroom/legora-netdocuments-secure-seamless-ai-powered-legal-work) , when Legora became a launch partner for NetDocuments' ndConnect interoperability program. Where that initial integration let lawyers move documents securely between the two platforms, the MCP connection gives Legora's AI direct, governed access to the institutional knowledge that mutual customers keep in NetDocuments.


For mutual customers, NetDocuments is the system of record: their documents, matters, and years of accumulated work product live in their Document Management System. To provide Legora with the necessary context to generate the best outputs, lawyers historically had to know exactly where the relevant files sat and selected them manually. The MCP connection removes that step. A lawyer can now ask a question or start a workflow in Legora, and NetDocuments surfaces the relevant prior matters, filings, and precedent the user is permitted to see – all directly in Legora.


Through this deeper Legora – NetDocuments integration, mutual customers will be able to:


-


**Find the right documents for AI-powered work:** Instead of navigating countless folders and subfolders to assemble the right set of files, a user working in Legora can describe what they need and have NetDocuments search the DMS and surface the relevant documents automatically.


-


**Work with connected knowledge, not disconnected files:** NetDocuments' L[egal Context Graph](https://www.netdocuments.com/solutions/legal-ai-platform/) , which continuously maps how documents, matters, and parties relate to one another across the DMS, flows into Legora through this integration. That means Legora understands how a firm's documents fit together as a body of work, rather than treating them as isolated, disparate files, producing output shaped by how the organization actually works.


-


**Keep governance intact on every request:** The access controls, ethical walls, and permissions already enforced in NetDocuments automatically govern any document access on the Legora platform. Each time a Legora user searches NetDocuments, they receive only the documents they are already entitled to see. Existing governance stays current and enforced, removing the risk of a user accidentally crossing an ethical wall or access boundary while using AI.


"With this connection between NetDocuments and Legora, a lawyer no longer needs to hunt for the correct documents through folders and subfolders before Legora can help," said Gabriel Quek, Senior Director of Technology Partnerships at Legora. "Lawyers simply describe the task on Legora, and the relevant precedent and matter history come to them, already understood in relation to one another and always within the permissions the firm has set. It reflects how we build: complementary to the systems legal teams already trust, and focused on helping lawyers do their best work."


"Legora has been building on ndConnect since the day we launched it, so extending our MCP connection to Legora was a natural next step in the partnership," said Heath Harris, VP of Applied AI at NetDocuments. "What makes this integration distinctive is what happens after you ask the AI a question or ask it to take an action: the precedent, matter history, and relationships captured in a firm's DMS flow directly into Legora's agentic review and drafting workflows, with our governance, permissions and ethical walls enforced on every request. For mutual customers, the experience their firm has spent years building in NetDocuments, now continuously updated in our Legal Context Graph, will actively shape the work they produce in Legora."


**Built on a foundation of secure, in-context legal work**


The MCP connection extends the vision behind the two companies' original integration. When Legora joined ndConnect in 2025, the goal was to let lawyers act on NetDocuments-stored content without the manual downloading, re-uploading, and version juggling that introduces risk and slows work down. The MCP connection advances that further: rather than a user selecting files to move, Legora's agentic AI can reach into NetDocuments for the relevant context on demand, grounded in the firm's own experience and governed by the same rules that apply everywhere else in the DMS.


This matters most on exactly the work where precedent is decisive - drafting from a firm's prior agreements, reviewing a new contract against how similar terms were handled before, or getting up to speed on a matter without reconstructing its history by hand. By pairing Legora's agentic operating system with NetDocuments' governed institutional knowledge, mutual customers spend less time locating and validating precedent and gain more confidence that output reflects how their organization actually works.


The companies will make the connection available to mutual customers, with capabilities and availability communicated over time.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 100,000 legal professionals at more than 1,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 50 markets.


**About NetDocuments**


NetDocuments, the #1 trusted cloud-native document management system (DMS) for 25+ years, delivers everything lawyers need to do their best work, including award-winning automation and AI to email management, search, collaboration, document bundling, advanced security, and more. With the industry's first legal context graph and a reimagined user experience built around it, NetDocuments supercharges those experiences by connecting every matter, every project, and every case while respecting an organization's permissions and ethical walls. Supporting more than 7,000 law firms, corporate legal departments, and public sector organizations worldwide, the platform integrates with 150+ other technologies, including Microsoft 365, Claude by Anthropic, and Docusign, making it a core solution that meets users wherever they work. To learn more, visit netdocuments.com.
